summary: Matched BEFORE and AFTER captures reloaded from the same saved draft now carry a transaction date (01/15/2026), real-property ATC DO122, Nature=Transfer of Real Property Classified as Capital Asset, real Lot / Improvement text, and a 9-digit Schedule 1.A total (316,059,480.62) so Item 1 Date of Transaction, Part II Tax Due, Schedule 1.A Lot / Improvement, and Schedule 2 Item 1B all print non-blank. All remaining print defects on 2000OT are shared crates/bir-print issues (Schedule 1.B col (a) unreadable micro-text, Schedule 1.A rows 6-15 omitted while the printed total 316,059,480.62 still includes them, comb-tick collisions, left-aligned schedule amounts). Open-row BEFORE/AFTER captures (screen-04b-part-iv-schedules-row-open.png) confirm the UI row drawer already displays official BIR headings from forms/schema-overrides.json; the 80 label updates in forms/forms-schema.json clean the underlying schema data.

Schedule 1.B column (a) (Name of Corporate Stock) shrinks long stock names to unreadable micro-text (~3-4pt) because crates/bir-print forces single-line <input> fitting (see print-p2-sched1b-zoom.png). Proposal: allow crates/bir-print to wrap text cells with height >= 18pt onto 2 lines at a minimum readable font size (6.5-7pt, line-height 8.5pt), truncating with an ellipsis if still overflowing and carrying full names onto a continuation sheet.
